title: Fictional technical test of model-gateway allowlist enforcement
description: Fictional Test output used to illustrate a catalog `technical_test` evidence record for a sampled gateway safeguard.
collection_method: Executed the fictional Test script and retained stdout, expected results, and environment metadata.

scope.description: Fictional production-like model gateway allowlist enforcement for blocked model identifiers.

population.description: Five fictional blocked model identifiers and three allowed identifiers configured on the gateway.
population.sample: All five blocked identifiers and one allowed control identifier.
population.selection_rationale: The catalog example needs a small reproducible Test sample.

relevance.rationale: The Test exercises the fictional allowlist safeguard under examination.

reliability.rationale: Method, expected results, and observed outcomes are retained with the run metadata.

completeness.rationale: All sampled identifiers and the control case are present in the retained output.

timeliness.rationale: The Test ran during the fictional assessment fieldwork window.

attribution.rationale: Tester identity, harness identity, and environment label are recorded.

integrity.rationale: The fictional digest illustrates verification without asserting real assurance.

traceability.rationale: The example links the Test to a fictional procedure and assessment result.

quality.sufficiency_rationale: One harness run is limited evidence and needs configuration and change-record corroboration in a real engagement.

limitations: This fictional catalog example does not demonstrate an actual technical testing program.
The harness environment is labeled production-like and is not claimed to be the live production plane.

retention.end_condition: Retain until the fictional assessment archive period ends.

example_notice: Fictional non-authoritative example; no organization, ESAF control, profile, or external framework has been assessed.
